reference.provenance: Reference revisions supplied by integration owner; scanned content is identified by source hashes below

method.sourceScope: Recursive regular source files in public/lib/bin, three package entry sources, native parity JSON and canonical plan; no dependencies, tests, app execution or settings reads
limits: Quoted HTML attributes and literal markup candidates only; JS-created controls are represented by source functions/dynamic families, not complete DOM instances.
JavaScript scanning is lexical, not an AST or call graph. Nearest preceding named function is a locator only; anonymous callbacks inherit that locator.
Source IDs and symbol/data anchors identify records; line numbers are navigation hints. Anonymous tag hashes can change when markup changes; duplicate instances use occurrence suffixes.

Browser key declarations and access expressions are enumerated. Dynamic keys remain expressions. Server settings contracts are linked in capability-ledger.md; schema references do not prove writes or runtime availability.
Family matching is a deterministic lexical annotation. Unresolved entries require human reconciliation; zero unresolved would not establish runtime parity.
